title: Animals in the Wild
text:
Lions live in Africa. They live in groups called prides. A lion is a big cat with a long tail. Lions sleep for many hours each day.

Elephants are the biggest land animals. They eat grass, leaves and fruit. Elephants live in large families. A baby elephant drinks milk from its mother.

questions.text: Why does a baby elephant probably stay close to its mother?
options: Because it does not like grass
Because it needs milk and protection

questions.text: Why do lions probably live in groups?
options: They are safer and can hunt together

vocabulary.definition: a big wild cat with a long tail that lives in Africa
a number of animals or people that live or work together
a green plant that grows on the ground and that animals eat
a white drink that a baby animal gets from its mother

paragraph_translations: Lwy żyją w Afryce. Żyją w grupach zwanych dumami. Lew jest dużym kotem z długim ogonem. Lwy śpią wiele godzin każdego dnia.
Słonie są największymi zwierzętami lądowymi. Jedzą trawę, liście i owoce. Słonie żyją w dużych rodzinach. Małe słoniątko pije mleko od swojej matki.
